learning: No LOOP occurred on this trail — the one real methodology bug (shell-escaping of Windows backslash paths across bash/JSON/node producing untrustworthy test results) was caught and corrected by the Maker/Checker before any Checker rejection, not after one. Per .pmcro/earned-constraints.md's own promotion rule ('each entry exists because a Checker rejected a Maker's attempt'), this does not qualify for promotion to earned-constraints.md — that mechanism is for corrected LOOPs, not for a single actor's mid-work self-correction. Recording the lesson here in the trail itself is sufficient: when a hook/script test payload needs a Windows absolute path with backslashes, write it to a JSON fixture file rather than constructing it through nested shell string interpolation.
